parameter_status: Fault magnitudes, timing distributions, thresholds, clock bounds, and mission scale require justified models and pilots.

scenarios.name: Clean reconnect
questions: What additional admission delay is introduced when navigation and software evidence are healthy?

scenarios.name: Temporary GNSS loss during reconnect
questions: How does growing navigation uncertainty change permitted roles and time to useful service?

scenarios.name: Step-biased GNSS observations
questions: What are monitor misses, false exclusions, and unsafe role grants against independent position truth?

scenarios.name: Slow GNSS position drift
questions: When can slowly changing bias evade a selected monitor and invalidate a role assignment?

scenarios.name: Benign IMU drift with noisy GNSS
questions: How often does benign degradation cause false exclusion or unnecessary update deferral?

scenarios.name: Stale or replayed rejoining evidence
questions: Do challenge binding and evidence-age checks withdraw inappropriate role permissions?

scenarios.name: Authorized but role-incompatible release
questions: Can an independently safe restricted role supply useful service before an update?

scenarios.name: Artifact or manifest tampering
questions: Does actual verification fail before activation and admission?

scenarios.name: Replay of obsolete authorized metadata
questions: Do persistent-state and freshness rules reject prohibited images even when signatures are valid?

scenarios.name: Interrupted download
questions: Does the active image remain usable and how long does verified resumable delivery take?

scenarios.name: Failed activation with a permitted fallback
questions: Does recovery restore an authorized healthy state and trigger new navigation/software appraisal?

scenarios.name: Failed activation without a usable authorized fallback
questions: Does the system preserve isolation and report service loss rather than a false recovery success?

scenarios.name: Untrusted GNSS-derived time
questions: How does independent time availability or bounded clock uncertainty affect update freshness and legitimate rejoining?

scenarios.name: Joint navigation fault and failed software update
questions: Does joint control add value beyond independent navigation gates and static secure update rules?

scenarios.name: No feasible swarm capacity
questions: Is the mission capability shortfall reported without relaxing hard security conditions?
